testedBehavior: The actual Claude Code 2.1.270 Write tool rejected a precreated file that had not been read, without changing its bytes. The Claude process exited 0 while the individual Write result was an error.

With Read unavailable, the same host created a new file under a mode-0700 temporary directory. Its mode-0644 child preserved the harmless JSON bytes literally, including quotes, command-substitution syntax and backticks; no shell marker was created.

relationshipToSource.testedContract: Supports the new-file-under-private-directory staging pattern used by the reviewed workflows and shared journal fragment.
relationshipToSource.scope: This observation predates the source-freeze commit and directly tests host Write semantics in print mode with a deterministic local model and Write preallowed. It did not execute a generated skill or the journal fragment, and did not exercise terminal confirmation UI or autonomous model reasoning.
